title: Mouse intestinal organoid time-course experiments from single cells
protocol: Remove the medium from the wells and collect Matrigel droplets containing organoids with ice cold PBS into a falcon tube (use 0.5 ml of PBS per well).
Centrifuge the tube for 5 min at 400 rcf and 4°C to pellet the organoids.
Discard supernatant and re-suspend pellet in Tryple (add 100 µl of Tryple with 10 µM of Rock inhibitor for each collected well).
Incubate 20 min at 37°C with harsh pipetting every five minutes.
Add DMEM/F-12 (~3 times the amount of used Tryple) and centrifuge for 5 min at 400 rcf and 4°C.
Discard supernatant and re-suspend in 0.5 ml of cold PBS (PBS plus 10 µM Rock inhibitor).
Filter cell suspension through a 30 μm cell strainer directly into a FACS sorting tube.
Keep samples on ice until sorting (ideally this should be done within 30 min).
Prepare a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube with 200 µl of ENR medium (add 10 µM Rock inhibitor to ENR medium) to collect the sample (collection tube, store on ice).
FACS sort single alive cells into prepared collection tube.
After sorting, centrifuge collection tube for 5 min at 800 rcf and 4°C.
Discard supernatant carefully.
Re-suspend pellet in a 1:1 ratio of ENR medium and Matrigel.
Seed 5 µl droplet of the prepared cell suspension for each well of a 96 well-plate.
Incubate the plate for 15-20 min at 37°C in an incubator to let the droplets solidify.
Add 100 µl/well of ENR medium supplemented with 20% Wnt3a-CM, 10µM of Rock inhibitor, and 3µM of CHIR99021.
After 24h replace medium with 100 µl of ENR medium containing 20% Wnt3a-CM and 10µM of Rock inhibitor.
After 72h replace medium with 100 µl of ENR medium only.
Remove ENR medium.
Add 100 µl/well of 5 µM Verteporfin or DMSO diluted in ENR medium at the time point of interest.
Remove ENR medium from the wells.
Add 100 µl/well of 0.05 µg/ml Doxycycline hyclate or ddH₂O diluted in ENR medium at the time point of interest.
Change medium daily adding fresh compound or ddH₂O and supplement as described until fixation.
Culture organoids growing in a 24-well plate with 500 µl/well of 1 µg/ml 4-Hydroxytamoxifen or DMSO diluted in ENR medium for 24 h before single cell isolation.
Grow single cells in normal ENR medium until fixation as described.
Remove ENR medium from the wells.
Add 100 µl/well of 10 µM DAPT or DMSO in ENR medium at the time point of interest.
Change medium daily adding fresh compound and supplement as described until fixation.
Remove ENR medium from the wells.
Add 100 µl/well of 0.5 µM Ly411575 or MK-0752 or DMSO in ENR medium.
Remove ENR medium.
Add 100 µl/well of 5 µM CHIR99021 or 2 µM IWP-2, or respective DMSO concentrations in ENR.
Change medium daily adding fresh compound and supplement as specified until fixation.
Remove ENR medium.
Add 100 µl/well of 0.5 µg/ml EREG or PBS diluted in ENR.
Change medium daily adding fresh compound and supplement as specified until fixation.
Spin the 96-well plate at 3000 rpm for 10 min in a pre-cooled centrifuge at 10°C prior to fixation.
Wash each well once with 100 µl of PBS before adding 100 µl of 4% PFA diluted in PBS for 45 min at room temperature.
Wash each well three times with PBS (100 µl/well).
Seal plates with Parafilm to prevent evaporation of PBS.
Add 100 μl of permeabilization buffer, incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (shake plate at 300 rpm).
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
Add 100 μl of blocking buffer and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (shake plate at 300 rpm).
Dilute the primary antibody to an appropriate concentration in blocking buffer, add 60 μl/well, and incubate for 2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
Dilute the secondary antibody 1:500 in blocking buffer and add 100 μl/well, incubating for 1 hour at room temperature (shake plate at 300 rpm).
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
Stain cell nuclei with 100 μl/well DAPI (20 μg/ml diluted in ddH₂O) for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
To stain cell outlines, add CellTrace dye to the CellTrace buffer (final concentration 1 µg/ml), and immediately add 100 μl/well for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash with PBS (100 μl/well).
Wash with PBS (100 μl/well).
Wash with PBS (100 μl/well).
Seal plates with Parafilm to prevent evaporation of PBS.
Cover plates with aluminum foil to protect fluorophores from light exposure.
Incubate each well in 100 µl of optical clearing solution at room temperature for 20 min.
Replace optical clearing solution with 100 µl of fresh optical clearing solution after incubation.
Wash sample with PBS to remove optical clearing solution after imaging.
Wash wells 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well) followed by 3 washes of 10 minutes each with PBS (200 μl/well, shake plate at 300 rpm).
Add 100 μl/well of multiplexing blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature (shake plate at 300 rpm).

Dilute the primary antibody to an appropriate concentration in multiplexing blocking buffer and add 60 μl/well, incubate for 2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4°C depending on the used antibody.
Wash wells 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
Dilute the secondary antibody with a concentration of 1:500 in multiplexing blocking buffer and add 100 μl/well for 1 hour at room temperature (shake plate at 300 rpm).
Wash wells 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
Stain cell nuclei with 100 μl/well of DAPI (20 μg/ml diluted in ddH₂O) for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash wells 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
To stain cell outlines, add CellTrace dye to the CellTrace buffer (final concentration 1 µg/ml) and immediately add 100 μl into each well for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash wells 3 times with PBS (100 μl/well).
Add 200 μl of imaging buffer per well and image.
Wash the plate 3 times for 10 minutes each with elution buffer at room temperature using 100 μl per well (shake plate at 300 rpm).
Wash the plate 3 times briefly with PBS, followed by 3 washes for 10 minutes each with PBS using 200 μl per well (shake plate at 300 rpm).
Re-block the plate by adding 100 μl of multiplexing blocking buffer per well and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (shake plate at 300 rpm).

Dilute next set of antibodies to appropriate concentration in multiplexing blocking buffer, add 60 μl per well, and incubate for 2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4°C depending on the antibody used.
Wash the plate 3 times with PBS using 100 μl per well.
Dilute secondary antibody to a concentration of 1:500 in multiplexing blocking buffer, add 100 μl per well, and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (shake plate at 300 rpm).
Wash the plate 3 times with PBS using 100 μl per well.
Re-stain nuclei by adding 100 μl of DAPI (20 µg/ml diluted in ddH₂O) per well and incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the plate 3 times with PBS using 100 μl per well.
Add 200 µl of imaging buffer per well.
Remove the culture medium and wash the wells with 100 µl of PBS.
Scrape the cells embedded in Matrigel with 100 µl/well of Buffer RL + b-mercaptoethanol.
Add 30 µl/well of ethanol 97% to the lysate.
Mix the lysate by vortexing.
Follow the protocol of the Single Cell RNA Purification Kit from Section 2.
Total RNA Purification from All Types of Lysate
Perform DNase treatment as an optional step described in Appendix A
Elute RNA in 20 µl of Elution Solution A
